attempts.text:
Car1 at Thakre shelter has no usable roads, so it cannot move. Car2 does all the work. Its trips to Suryagadhi market would cost 228 minutes round trip and save at most 220 in penalties, so those 12 people are deferred. The Uttargaya and Trishuli people are rescued in two trips, and the Belkot and Panchakanya adults are deferred because reaching them costs more than their penalties.

<plan>
drive car2 nilkantha-hospital tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village trishuli-care-home
drive car2 trishuli-care-home uttargaya-market
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 uttargaya-market trishuli-care-home
drive car2 trishuli-care-home tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village nilkantha-hospital
unload car2 adult 4
drive car2 nilkantha-hospital tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village trishuli-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 trishuli-care-home tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village nilkantha-hospital
unload car2 elderly 3
defer suryagadhi-market elderly 4

defer belkot-village adult 1

</plan>
